a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate to 8, then take) only works if two storms in a row miss, about 4% for each of us. Holding 0 cells is fatal, so I plan to take 4 in round 1. I won't take more than 4. After that I'll operate every round so the generator keeps running for you. If you'd rather split differently, tell me now.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. Waiting with 0 cells under an 80% storm risk is too likely to be fatal. I won't take anything more. From now on I'll operate every round so we can rebuild the reserve for you.
